answer: Because the timing is entered against the orchard challenge, the zephyr audit can replay the ember history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 84 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Scaling to 889 identities multiplies that fee by 846 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
